_meta.notes: Expert-calibrated TAM parameters for each disease in OPPORTUNITY_UNIVERSE. Each disease uses a formula appropriate to its product category. Pricing anchored to the closest approved comparator drug/device WAC. All TAM values in USD.

formulas.drug_prevalence: TAM = prevalent_patients × diagnosis_rate × treatment_rate × novel_eligible_fraction × price_per_year_usd × net_price_factor
formulas.drug_incidence: TAM = annual_incidence × treatment_rate × novel_eligible_fraction × price_per_course_usd × net_price_factor
formulas.gene_therapy: TAM = annual_eligible_cohort × price_per_treatment_usd × net_price_factor  (steady-state annual demand)
formulas.device: TAM = target_facilities × adoption_rate × annual_contract_usd  OR  addressable_patients × adoption_rate × annual_cost_per_patient_usd × net_price_factor
formulas.vaccine: TAM = target_population × vaccination_rate × doses_per_series × price_per_dose_usd × net_price_factor

Glioblastoma Multiforme.pricing_rationale: Bevacizumab/temozolomide combination ~$80-120K; novel immunotherapy commands 25% premium. 65% of GBM patients progress to a treatment line where novel agent is eligible.

Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma.pricing_rationale: mFOLFIRINOX + nab-paclitaxel ~$100K; novel KRAS G12D or stroma-targeting agent would command 2x premium. 55% eligible = resectable/locally advanced + 2L+ metastatic.

ALS (SOD1-mutant).pricing_rationale: Tofersen (Qalsody) WAC $178K/yr is the comparator anchor. Next-gen oral/broader-coverage agent targets all ALS (not just SOD1), but discovery is SOD1-informed.

Carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales.pricing_rationale: Avycaz WAC ~$15K/course; next novel last-resort agent targets $18-25K. Only 18% of CRE cases require a novel antibiotic (remainder respond to polymyxin/ceftazidime combinations).

Acinetobacter baumannii MDR.pricing_rationale: Sulbactam-durlobactam (Xacduro) WAC ~$15-16K/course. 75% of MDR A. baumannii cases have no adequate alternative, making novel agent highly eligible.

Spinal Muscular Atrophy Type 2.pricing_rationale: Risdiplam (Evrysdi) WAC $340K/yr; Spinraza (nusinersen) $750K yr-1, $375K/yr maintenance. Novel mechanism for Type 2 beyond-neonatal gap targets those ineligible for Zolgensma by age.

HER2-low Breast Cancer.pricing_rationale: Enhertu (T-DXd) WAC $180K/yr. Annual_incidence = ~50K metastatic HER2-low BC cases (not all 185K new HER2-low diagnoses; most are early-stage). 65% eligible = those progressing on prior HER2-targeting or eligible for 1L ADC.

KRAS G12C NSCLC.pricing_rationale: Sotorasib (Lumakras) WAC $180K/yr; adagrasib (Krazati) $200K/yr. Novel combination or 2nd-gen G12C inhibitor targets those who progressed on 1L or are combination-eligible.

Huntington Disease.pricing_rationale: No approved DMT (tetrabenazine/deutetrabenazine are symptomatic only). First disease-modifying agent commands orphan drug premium. Benchmark: riluzole $10K/yr (generic ALS) vs tofersen $178K. HD DMT likely $100-150K given rarity.

Friedreich Ataxia.pricing_rationale: Skyclarys (omaveloxolone) WAC $340K/yr. Second-mechanism agent (e.g., frataxin stabilizer, epigenetic) targets those with inadequate Nrf2 pathway response or as combination.

C. difficile Infection.pricing_rationale: Fidaxomicin (Dificid) WAC ~$4K; bezlotoxumab (Zinplava) prophylaxis ~$4K. Novel microbiome/phage approach targets recurrent CDI (25% of all CDI cases), where standard therapy fails.

MRSA Skin Infections.pricing_rationale: Generic TMP-SMX $4/course creates price ceiling pressure. Novel oral MRSA agent targets TMP-SMX-resistant/intolerant fraction (~12%). Delafloxacin (Baxdela) $1,200/course is the relevant comparator for outpatient premium oral.

Type 1 Diabetes (CGM/automated insulin).pricing_rationale: Tandem Control-IQ system + Dexcom G7: ~$10-14K/yr all-in. Omnipod 5 + CGM: ~$9-12K/yr. Net price after insurance reimbursement ~70% of list. 55% of T1D patients are AID-eligible (exclude very young, very old, contraindicated).

Alzheimer Disease (early/MCI).pricing_rationale: Leqembi WAC $26,500/yr; Kisunla $32K/yr. Prevalent_patients = 1.5M amyloid-positive early-stage/MCI (biomarker-confirmed eligible subset of 6.7M total). 80% eligible for a next-gen anti-amyloid or tau-targeting agent.

Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension.pricing_rationale: Sotatercept (Winrevair) WAC $168K/yr; selexipag (Uptravi) $80K/yr. Novel mechanism targets patients inadequate on background ERA+PDE5i therapy (~45% of prevalent PAH).

Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy.pricing_rationale: Elevidys WAC $3.2M one-time (~$1.2M/yr amortized over 3-yr treatment benefit). Exon-skipping drugs (Vyondys, Amondys) $1-1.3M/yr. Gene therapy wave targets the 55% who are exon-amenable or mutation-agnostic eligible.

Myelofibrosis JAK-resistant.pricing_rationale: Ruxolitinib WAC $170K/yr; pacritinib (Vonjo) $181K/yr; momelotinib (Ojjaara) $209K/yr. JAK-resistant patients (~40% of MF after 12 months) are the unmet 2nd/3rd-line opportunity.

Geographic Atrophy (dry AMD).pricing_rationale: Syfovre (pegcetacoplan) WAC $2,190/injection × 8/yr = $17.5K; Izervay (avacincaptad) $3,500 × 6/yr = $21K. Novel intravitreal agent (different mechanism) prices within this range. 70% of GA patients not yet on a complement inhibitor.

Sickle Cell Disease (gene therapy).pricing_rationale: Casgevy WAC $2.2M; Lyfgenia $3.1M. Annual_eligible_cohort = steady-state demand after backlog cleared: ~5K severe SCD (HbSS) aged 12-35 meeting eligibility criteria per year. Peak penetration 35% reflects competition between gene therapies and next-gen hydroxyurea/voxelotor combinations.

RSV in elderly/immunocompromised.pricing_rationale: Arexvy/Abrysvo WAC $200/dose. Novel longer-acting (2+ year) or combination RSV+influenza vaccine would target 60M adults 65+ in the US. Annual booster fraction (~50%) drives recurring revenue.

Sepsis (AI early detection).pricing_rationale: Hospital AI subscription benchmark: Epic-integrated monitoring ~$200-500K/yr per facility. 5,800 US hospitals with ICU. Premium positioning requires demonstrated mortality reduction vs Epic Sepsis Model baseline.

NASH/MASH.pricing_rationale: Rezdiffra WAC $47,400/yr. Novel_eligible = 65% of diagnosed+treated patients not on or inadequately responding to resmetirom. 35% formal diagnosis rate reflects NASH underdiagnosis (most detected incidentally via elevated ALT).

Prostate Cancer (PSMA-targeted).pricing_rationale: Pluvicto (lutetium PSMA-617) WAC $174K/course. Annual_incidence = mCRPC new cases/yr. 55% PSMA-positive and eligible for novel PSMA-targeted ADC or combo vs Pluvicto alone.

Bipolar Depression.pricing_rationale: Caplyta (lumateperone) WAC $15K/yr. 30% novel-eligible = those with treatment-resistant bipolar depression (inadequate on lithium + quetiapine + lamotrigine). Low penetration reflects crowded CNS market and long switching cycles.

Rare Pediatric Epilepsy (SCN1A).pricing_rationale: Fintepla (fenfluramine) WAC $180K/yr. Novel SCN1A gene therapy or next-gen sodium channel modulator targets 60% who are inadequately controlled on fenfluramine + clobazam combination.
